SCORES.title: Scoreboard
SCORES.description: Manage scores, audible round signals and sport-dependent foul counters.
SCORES.importedTeamsNotice: Imported the first two teams from the saved team session.
SCORES.tournamentHandoffHint: Teams and current lineup will be transferred to the tournament.
SCORES.liveModeHint: Live synchronisation is an optional extension and does not require a server. In default mode all data stays local.
SCORES.invalidTimer: Enter a duration between 1 second and 99:59.
SCORES.sharedNumberHint: Matching numbers play for both teams. Each new round starts only when confirmed.
SCORES.twoTeamCountdownRequired: Number selection requires 2 teams and countdown mode.
SCORES.invalidRoundSettings: Configure valid team size, player count, 2 teams and countdown.
SCORES.noEligibleNumbers: Not enough eligible numbers. Start a new cycle or change the rule.
SCORES.chooseNumbers: Select the required number of players first.
SCORES.soundUnavailable: Audio unavailable. Check the device volume and browser.
SCORES.foulNote: Fouls and suspensions are counted manually. No automatic penalties or free throws are applied.
SCORES.soundNote: One tone on start, two short warning tones at 10 seconds remaining, three on time-up. On iPad, sound requires active browser playback.
SCORES.ownSoundsHint: Short audio files up to 256 KiB each; stored locally in this browser and not included in JSON backups.
SCORES.customSoundUnavailable: Custom audio failed; using the default signal.
SCORES.basketballRulesNote: After the fourth team foul in a quarter, later fouls lead to two free throws. Five player fouls mean exclusion. Fouls on shots have special penalties. Points are never awarded automatically.
SCORES.bonusActive: Team foul penalty: 2 free throws from the fifth (except special cases)
SCORES.technicalNoPenaltyDefined: The rules sheet specifies no direct free-throw penalty for technical fouls.
SCORES.legacyFouls: Previous foul total without quarter assignment
SCORES.invalidSoundFile: Select an audio file between 1 and 256 KiB.
